group.title: Design studio chat
group.passage:
PROJECT CHAT — RIVER HOTEL BROCHURE
Tuesday, 2:10 p.m.

Mina: The client approved the room photographs, but the map still shows the old tram stop. The new stop is on Cedar Avenue, one block east.
Jon: I'll correct the map. Are we still sending the brochure to the printer at four?
Mina: That's the plan. We also need the hotel's written approval of the final prices before we release it.
Eva: I called their manager. She's in a meeting until three, but her assistant will send the signed price sheet within the hour.
Jon: Great. The map will be ready in twenty minutes. What about the cover headline?
Mina: Leave it as it is. They approved that yesterday.
Eva: The price sheet has just arrived. One change: breakfast is now included in the family package, at the same price. I'll update that paragraph.
Mina: Thanks. Once the revised map and paragraph are in, send me the PDF. I'll give it one last look before it goes out.
group.passageZh:
專案對話：River 飯店手冊
星期二下午二點十分

Mina：客戶核准客房照片了，但地圖仍標舊電車站，新站在往東一街區的 Cedar Avenue。
Jon：我來改地圖。還是四點送印嗎？
Mina：計畫不變。送印前也要取得飯店對最終價格的書面核准。
Eva：我打給經理了。她開會到三點，但助理會在一小時內寄來簽過名的價目表。
Jon：太好了，地圖二十分鐘後完成。封面標題呢？
Mina：維持原樣，昨天已核准。
Eva：價目表剛到。有一項變更：家庭方案現在含早餐，價格不變。我來更新那段。
Mina：謝謝。把修訂後的地圖和段落放進手冊後，把 PDF 寄給我。我會在送出前最後檢查一次。
